title: WaterWiseKids Swim School Transparency Standard
badge_meaning: The school disclosed the required fields, linked evidence or provided a dated attestation, and passed a completeness review. It is not a safety certification, quality rating, endorsement, accreditation, or inspection.
sort_policy: Payment never changes badge eligibility or the default order of standard directory results. A paid placement must remain separately labeled.

evidence_classes.label: Official public source
evidence_classes.description: A current page or document controlled by the school, facility, credential issuer, or government agency.

evidence_classes.label: Dated school attestation
evidence_classes.description: A named authorized representative attests to a field that is not publicly documented. The listing labels it school-submitted.

evidence_classes.label: Not stated
evidence_classes.description: The field is not disclosed. It is never converted to no, none, or noncompliant.

required_fields.label: Credential or training bodies the school says it uses
Maximum instructor-to-student ratio by level or program
Pool setting, season, and stated water temperature or not stated
Current pricing, required fees, lesson duration, and checked date
Ownership, sponsorship, or other material relationship with WWK

revocation_reasons: ownership or sponsorship conflict is omitted
badge is displayed as a safety certification or endorsement
